_README: Sanctum question bank, selected by the standardized per-user code: band + status (open/partial/blocked) + dosha (V/P/K). Questions are deliberately GENERAL -- they must land for any user carrying that code, never assume one person's biography. Band-specific sets key off status; dosha sets are global because dosha is a whole-system condition, not a band condition. Falls back to CHAKRAS[].advancedQs when a condition set is exhausted.

blocked: What would have to be true for you to feel safe in your own body today?
Where does your body brace when you think about money? Name the exact place.
What are you afraid would happen if you actually measured what you have?
partial: What is the one number you have been avoiding writing down?
Which part of your ground is solid right now, and which part is still guesswork?
open: What holds you steady, and have you ever thanked it out loud?
You have ground under you. What could you build on it that you have been postponing?

blocked: What have you stopped letting yourself want?
Where did your pleasure go quiet, and what happened just before it did?
partial: What wants to be created through you that you keep deferring?
When did you last feel genuine delight, and what conditions made it possible?
open: What is flowing in you right now that deserves to be given room?
What does your desire know that your plans do not?

blocked: Where are you spending power to look right instead of to be effective?
What are you angry about that you have not let yourself say plainly?
What would you do today if you were not managing anyone's reaction to it?
partial: Where does your fire cook, and where does it burn?
What decision are you postponing because making it would require being disliked?
open: Your will is working. What is it pointed at, and did you choose that on purpose?
When did power last feel clean in your hands?

blocked: Who are you protecting yourself from, and what did it cost to build that wall?
What grief have you filed away as handled that is not actually handled?
What would you say to someone you love if being right did not matter?
partial: Where are you giving love in a form the other person cannot receive?
What do you need to hear that you have never asked anyone for?
open: Who has not heard from you lately who should?
What does your love make possible that you have not yet let it do?

blocked: What is the sentence you keep not saying, and who is it for?
Where do you go quiet to keep the peace, and what does that silence cost?
What truth would change something if you finally said it out loud?
partial: Where do you speak around a thing instead of into it?
What have you paid most for saying, and would you say it again?
open: Your voice is working. What is it time to say, and to whom?
What can you say now that you could not have said a year ago?

blocked: What do you already know that you keep asking other people to confirm?
What would you have to put down to see clearly again?
Where are you mistaking noise for information?
partial: What has your intuition been repeating that you keep overruling?
When did you last act on something you could not justify, and how did it turn out?
open: What are you seeing right now that you have not written down?
What is becoming clear that you are not ready to say yet?

blocked: What did you stop trusting, and what happened right before you stopped?
If you are not talking to whatever is larger than you, when did that conversation end?
What are you doing that has meaning, and what are you doing only from momentum?
partial: What faith remains when everything else empties out?
What is the work actually for, underneath the reasons you give people?
open: What do you trust, and how do you know it is trustworthy?
What is being asked of you right now that you already know the answer to?

V: What in your life is changing faster than you can land on it?
Where do you need weight and regularity more than you need another option?
What did you eat today, and when did you sleep? Answer before anything strategic.
P: Where are you pushing when the situation is asking you to cool down?
What are you trying to win that would be better resolved than won?
Where has your sharpness been useful lately, and where has it just been sharp?
K: What has been sitting heavy and unmoved for longer than it should have?
Where would movement help more than more thinking?
What are you holding onto out of comfort rather than value?
